name: compare_detection
description: giap compare: the gene x run detection matrix (section matrix) and the exact UpSet intersections of the detected sets (section intersection), long form (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.9.3; M9-22, ADR-0046). The table has no coordinate fields.

fields.name: locus_tag
fields.description: Gene (matrix rows; NA on intersection rows)

fields.name: run
fields.description: Run label (matrix rows; NA on intersection rows)

fields.name: detected
fields.description: Gene detected in the run (matrix rows)

fields.name: detection_status
fields.description: The run's detection status of the gene (matrix rows)

fields.name: intersection
fields.description: Runs whose detected sets hold exactly these genes, joined by & in label order, or none (intersection rows)

fields.name: n_genes
fields.description: Genes in the exact intersection (intersection rows)
